status: Shared Text byte_groups implemented and independently tested; Cat FES VM/load integration remains in progress
method: Owner-authorized local IDA9 static review only; original EXE/DLL never executed, no proprietary code/data distributed

functions.767050/765F40: FES token read uses6A5910 and6A54B0, not native41 delimiter splitter.765F40 additionally applies original string bank/localization policy, which is outside this generic byte kernel.
functions.6A5910: Raw byte delimiter set; parenthesis/quote groups; ASCII alphabetic saved-prefix before a group inserts NUL if currently inside a token. Group handling does not update the saved ordinary byte. Repeated delimiters collapse. Final WORD NUL. No6A7590/SJIS lead/trail boundary check.
functions.6A52F0: Quote helper strips delimiters while returning the consumed input length including a closing quote. It writes two NULs at payload end. Outer cursor still advances by consumed length, so subsequent visible NUL-list enumeration can end before later stored bytes. Backslash is not a quote escape. Unterminated quote copies to input end.
functions.6A5340: Parenthesis helper recursively copies nested groups, retains parentheses and treats quote bytes as ordinary content. Unterminated group copies to input end. Two NULs are written after the copied group.
functions.6A5910 colon branch: If second source byte is colon, helper bytes atoutput+2 are copied over the group start for consumed-3 bytes, and a NUL is written there. This preserves quote-helper quirks, including loss of first payload byte/included NUL for a closed quote-colon group. Intermediate helper tails beyond final cursor remain written. Native underflow for a too-short unwrap is rejected visibly by the safe API.
functions.6A54B0: Reads NUL-list item ordinal and stops at the first empty token; returned spans must index visible output tokens rather than source ranges.

shared_API.output: written_bytes retains every modified byte including helper tails;logical_len is finalcursor+WORD NUL;spans reference visible output bytes until first empty C-string.
shared_API.ownership: Pure shared CPU algorithm reusable without Cat; dual-pass capacity/overflow/depth preflight before allocating output, cancellation on both passes, errors never publish partial buffers. Native AST/value/resource/PC/wait semantics remain in the adapter.
shared_API.boundary: Explicit raw-byte protocol, not a normal argv/unicode tokenizer or SJIS-protected delimiter splitter.

validation.cases: nested/unclosed parentheses, quotes inside parentheses treated literally, saved alpha prefix, repeated/empty delimiters, normal quote NUL early termination, colon quoted/parenthesis unwrap and written tails, raw SJIS trail delimiter splitting, helper-written output capacity before allocation, nesting/token limits, cancellation during preflight and output pass
validation.not_claimed: No Cat FES execution/title/gameplay/callback success or completed integration. API docs coordinated with NNN for a later single regeneration; no reflective method invented.
